items.title: Senior Product Manager, Simple Trading
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Product Manager on the Simple Trading team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll own core parts of the retail trading experience used by millions of customers every day. This team builds delightful user experiences and UIs that optimize the primary buy, sell, and convert flows that drive Coinbase's consumer trading business. You'll define the product vision for your area, ship high-impact improvements across web and mobile, and partner closely with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to make crypto and perpetuals/derivatives trading engaging, delightful, and more trustworthy for every user. What you'll do: Own the end-to-end product roadmap for your area of the Simple Trading experience, from discovery and definition of engaging user experiences through execution, launch, and iteration across web and mobile UIs and platforms. Drive measurable improvements in trading conversion, user engagement, and revenue by identifying friction points, running experiments, and shipping data-informed solutions at scale. Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to deliver high-quality consumer trading experiences, balancing speed, reliability, and usability across core trading workflows. Shape the long-term product strategy for retail trading by synthesizing user research, market trends, regulatory requirements, and competitive dynamics into a clear, prioritized vision. Lead cross-functional alignment across Consumer Trade and partner teams, ensuring stakeholders across Tax, Legal, Compliance, and Finance are informed and engaged on key decisions. Required Skills and Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience shipping UI-heavy consumer products at scale, including at least 2 years working on trading, fintech, or marketplace products where conversion and revenue metrics were primary success measures. Deep familiarity with retail trading products, order types, and user workflows, with the ability to articulate what makes a trading experience intuitive and trustworthy. Proven ability to define and execute a product roadmap in high-ambiguity environments, with demonstrated results in improving core user flows visited by millions of users. Deep expertise in experimentation methodology, including designing A/B tests, defining success metrics, and interpreting results to inform product decisions with minimal analyst support. Fluency with data tools (SQL, Amplitude, or similar) sufficient to self-serve analyses, build dashboards, and monitor product health independently. Track record of driving alignment across senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, translating complex trade-offs into clear recommendations that accelerate decision-making. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Position ID: P78577 Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $218,025 — $256,500 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice . US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes .

items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Bitnomial is building the next generation US-based global derivatives exchange, starting with digital assets and progressively expanding to encompass a full spectrum of commodities worldwide. Bitnomial operates a US CFTC regulated exchange (DCM), clearinghouse (DCO), and brokerage (FCM). It offers a range of crypto-settled derivatives, including futures, options, and a suite of live perpetual futures, used by brokers, hedge funds, institutions, and trading firms around the world. Bitnomial's exchange, clearinghouse, and brokerage systems are written largely in Haskell. In this role you will build the services and data models that record every order, fill, and settlement at a CFTC-regulated exchange and clearinghouse, with the database as a first-class part of the design. You will build features across these systems and design the schema, queries, and migrations behind them. THE OPPORTUNITY - Improve build and release pipelines in GitHub Actions: caching, parallelism, pinned toolchains, and required tests and scans before production - Manage AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform, and run services as containers on Nomad - Build deployment tooling with health checks and automated rollback, and make deploys safe around market sessions - Add metrics and alerts to the services you build, so you can see whether a deploy worked - Monitor systems, respond to alerts, and support daily operations such as settlement cycles - Fix the cause of production issues and write down what you learned - Build, test, and ship well-reviewed features and fixes in our services across the exchange, clearinghouse, and brokerage. Most of the code is Haskell - Understand the order, trade, clearing, and settlement flows end to end WHAT YOU BRING - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI - Production experience with AWS and Docker, and infrastructure as code with Terraform - Strong Linux and scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar) - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a functional or strongly typed programming language such as Haskell, Rust, or C++ - Solid computer science fundamentals, including distributed systems: failure modes, retries and idempotency, consistency, and how to observe them across services - Willingness to take part in on-call and operational shifts - Care and rigor with code that moves money - Good judgment with AI tools. You use them to work faster, and you read, test, and understand what they produce before you ship it - A habit of asking why before changing something - Sound judgment under pressure, with a calm and methodical approach when production is live - Collaboration across engineering, operations, risk, and compliance, with a habit of documenting NICE TO HAVES - Financial knowledge or experience in trading, markets, or financial services - Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience - Experience with Nomad or Kubernetes - Experience with Nix, Ansible, Vault, or Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki - Haskell experience Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: GTM Enablement - Product
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re hiring our first Product Enablement specialist. You will join the Product & Technical Enablement team and help our go-to-market teams get ready for every product launch, across Agents, APIs, and Creative. You will support our global go-to-market teams. Your mission: help sellers understand, demo, and sell each new launch with confidence, with preparation that starts well before launch day. What sets this role apart: we’re looking for someone who knows our products well enough to demo them and sell them. You have used agents, APIs, or creative tools hands-on, and you can explain how they work and why they matter to customers. You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it. This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with: - Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships) - GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure) You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed. What you’ll do - Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of - Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value - Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence - Support product certification: help define what “product certified” means for GTM teams, and build the playbooks and training content that raise product confidence across the whole field, not only new hires - Support everboarding and onboarding: keep training tied to new releases and capabilities, and keep content current as products ship - Craft realistic practice environments: demo certifications, role-play scenarios, and customer simulations with scored feedback, built on our own agent technology - Operate AI-natively: use ElevenLabs’ own voice and agent technology to build training and practice environments; default to AI tools to build faster, and teach others to do the same - Measure what matters: define and track the percent of sellers certified within 2 weeks of GA, demo and pitch quality scores, and win rate and stage progression against named competitors, and use the data to improve each launch Requirements We’re looking for someone who knows our products well and can teach sellers to demo and sell them. You’ll thrive here if you: - Have 4-7+ years as an enterprise seller or solutions engineer, or as a seller who moved into product marketing or enablement, at a SaaS, platform, or API-first company - Are hands-on with agents, APIs, or creative tools, and understand at a conceptual level how they work - Have demoed and pitched technical products to customers, and can explain the value, not only the features - Have a track record of teaching, mentoring, or building training, in addition to your customer-facing work - Are comfortable building a program from scratch, with no playbook to inherit - Have credibility with sellers, built from time in the seat or supporting sellers directly, and work well with product marketing, research, and engineering teams - Communicate clearly and can adapt product material for different audiences without diluting it Bonus - Experience at a high-growth AI/ML, developer tools, or API-first company - Background in voice AI, conversational AI, or contact center technology - Vertical depth in financial services, healthcare, telecom or CCaaS, or at other AI companies - Hands-on experience with competing voice and agent platforms - Experience running workshops or labs for sellers or customers - Experience building role-play, simulation, or demo practice environments Location Remote-first, globally distributed role. Expect occasional travel to team hubs and onboarding sessions. Candidates should be able to work effectively across US and European time zones. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

ABOUT THE ROLE As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you'll build and run the ElevenLabs partner academy for systems integrators, hyperscalers and technology partners. You'll work closely with our regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who bring the technical expertise and set the technical quality bar. Your mission is to grow the program to 10,000+ certified partner professionals by the end of 2027, and to make the ElevenLabs certification a credential the tech ecosystem respects. As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you can expect to: - Build curricula for partner sellers, pre-sales and implementation engineers: courses, hands-on labs and assessments. - Turn expert knowledge from our FDEs, sales and product teams into a world-class online academy. - Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call. - Scale the program through automation, from automated agent review to bots and emails that support learners. - Deliver training online and in person, including sales and technical sessions at our partner hackathons. - Run program administration: the learning platform, partner onboarding tracks, reporting and learner feedback. You don't need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you need enough depth to work with senior engineers and sellers as subject matter experts and turn their knowledge into great learning. GROWTH POTENTIAL We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Leading a partner enablement team as the academy grows. - Moving into partner program leadership or Solutions Engineering. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America, with the ability to operate in Americas timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Incident Commander, Detection & Response - US
items.description: About the Team Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at OpenAI. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture. About the Role As an Incident Commander on Detection & Response, you’ll lead the response to complex security incidents affecting OpenAI’s intellectual property, customer data, and infrastructure. You’ll establish response priorities, coordinate technical work streams, drive containment and recovery decisions within agreed authority, and keep stakeholders informed as facts evolve. You’ll work with security and infrastructure teams across endpoints, identity, cloud, and compute environments, maintaining clear ownership and effective handoffs across time zones. Detection engineering knowledge is a supporting requirement: you’ll use telemetry and detection logic to assess evidence, identify visibility gaps, and guide improvements that make incident response more effective. In this role, you will: - Run incident command from initial assessment through containment, recovery, and closure, establishing severity, scope, response objectives, and escalation needs. - Assign work stream owners and coordinate investigation, containment, and recovery in parallel. Maintain a decision log and distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions. - Drive timely containment and recovery decisions with the appropriate owners, weighing security risk, evidence preservation, and operational impact within agreed decision rights. - Communicate incident status, impact, uncertainty, actions underway, and the next update to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. - Manage cross-time-zone handoffs with explicit command ownership, current status, outstanding risks, pending decisions, and next actions. - Improve response readiness through exercises, playbooks, and post-incident reviews; track agreed corrective actions with their owners. - Partner with detection engineers to evaluate telemetry and detection quality, close incident-related visibility gaps, and prioritize practical response automation. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have personally led complex security incidents as incident commander or an equivalent response lead, with clear examples of decisions, delegation, escalation, and outcomes. - Make sound decisions with incomplete information and revise them as evidence changes, balancing containment urgency with operational impact. - Coordinate responders across teams and time zones, resolve conflicting priorities, and maintain clear ownership during handoffs. - Communicate calmly and precisely under pressure, including concise stakeholder updates and explicit statements of uncertainty. - Have the security and infrastructure fundamentals to challenge investigation findings and assess containment and recovery options. - Understand detection engineering, including telemetry coverage, detection logic, false positives and false negatives, and validation. Can query and interpret evidence to support response decisions. - Turn incident lessons into practical improvements to readiness, playbooks, detection coverage, and response tooling. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. items.title: Security Engineer, RF and Technical Surveillance Countermeasures
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Part of that footprint is the radio spectrum around and inside each site: what transmits there, what listens there, and what the equipment itself gives off. You'll be the engineer who owns that domain end to end: on-site RF monitoring and detection, technical surveillance countermeasures (TSCM) and emanations security, from the threat basis through the systems that make the spectrum observable, to sign-off before a site opens. The engineering is in the monitoring and in the tooling that proves the controls hold: the sensors, receivers and their placement, the site baselines, and the detection logic that turns a rogue transmitter or an unexpected emitter into an alert an analyst trusts. External specialist partners do the hands-on sweep and measurement work; you write the scope, direct them on site and decide whether their report stands. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, sensor health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations, construction and legal teams, and directly with site operators and landlords. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure. Key responsibilities On-site RF monitoring and detection: design and develop the monitoring at each site: sensor, receiver and antenna selection and placement, the spectrum monitoring architecture, site RF baselines and what keeps them current, and detections that reach the team's security monitoring platform as alerts analysts keep trusting Tools, automation and AI agents: build the detection and classification tooling, the instruments and software for checks between sweeps, the findings and evidence records behind them, and the agents that triage alerts and watch sensor health. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it Technical surveillance countermeasures: own TSCM end to end: sweep cadence by space sensitivity, event-driven triggers such as fit-out, room turnover or an incident, scope and acceptance criteria per sweep, and findings handled with evidence and closure an assessor accepts Emanations security: set the posture for sites: the assessment method, zoning and separation, and shielding, filtering and protected cabling where warranted, written into the team's design and build standards so a site can build to them and an assessor can verify them Wireless and device policy by zone: detect which radios are actually present where (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, IoT, trunked radio) and produce the evidence that the policy holds on the floor Specialist partners: write the scope and the deliverable standard for sweep and assessment work, direct it on site, and decide in the acceptance review whether a report stands New sites and leases: carry RF and emanations requirements into design reviews, lease terms and pre-opening reviews, and sign off RF and emanations, including the pre-opening sweep and assessment, before a site opens Minimum qualifications Have built at least one RF monitoring or detection system end to end, from receiver and antenna choice through the software that turns captures into alerts Understand RF at the engineering level: propagation, modulation, spectrum analysis and antenna behavior, with hands-on use of the instruments that measure them, such as spectrum analyzers and software-defined radios Have planned and conducted TSCM sweeps yourself and can explain, from having done the work, what a sweep can and cannot find and how an adversary would get past it Have done RF security, TSCM or emanations work hands-on for data centers, critical infrastructure or a large hardware fleet Read and review code, design the data systems behind detection and monitoring tooling, and build automation (often with AI coding agents) using Git and code review Understand compromising emanations and what zoning, shielding and filtering each buy and cost, and write requirements for them that a construction team or a landlord can build to and an assessor can test Direct a specialist vendor without deferring to them: write the scope, check the work, reject a weak report Preferred qualifications Experience assessing compromising emanations and shielding or filtering tradeoffs in a live facility, and applying a formal emanations or counter-surveillance standard, government or commercial (TEMPEST, ICD 705 style construction requirements, or a corporate equivalent) Have built signal classification or spectrum analysis pipelines at scale, or tuned RF detections for a security operations workflow so operators kept trusting them Familiarity with airspace or drone RF detection, and with where it stops and on-site monitoring starts Experience at sites you did not fully control: colocation or multi-tenant facilities, where the RF environment and the walls are not yours alone Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual security work The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Core Infrastructure Engineering team builds and operates the shared data systems behind critical production services. Our estate spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with MariaDB at its centre and Kafka, Redis and Elasticsearch across the wider platform. We’re hiring a Principal Database Engineer to bring long-term experience and technical judgment to this estate. You’ll assess it, set the goals and direction, and work hands-on with the team to deliver measurable improvements. This is an individual contributor role with influence across teams and several quarters of work. THE OPPORTUNITY - Review the estate against business needs and production evidence. Judge reliability, scale, cost and operational complexity, identifying what should be preserved and where investment or simplification would make a difference. - Define the target architecture and measurable goals. Agree a prioritised roadmap with engineering leads and dependent teams, explaining the trade-offs and sequencing work around delivery risks. - Execute that roadmap with the team through design, implementation and adoption. Stay personally involved in difficult migrations and scaling decisions, with representative benchmarks, data-integrity checks and credible cutover and rollback plans. Adapt the plan as evidence changes and verify the results in production before calling the work complete. - Investigate difficult MariaDB failures and performance limits through the engine, storage and application behaviour. Improve fleet reliability through useful observability, safer changes and tested backup, restore and disaster recovery procedures. Set recovery objectives with service owners and prove them through exercises. - Build and maintain production software for database provisioning, upgrades and routine maintenance. Make self-service workflows safe and auditable, incorporating access controls and change evidence with Security and Compliance. - Work with application teams on schemas, transaction boundaries, queries and data-store choices. Make the operational consequences clear and resolve dependencies that span teams. - Mentor engineers across the team through design reviews, pairing and incident analysis. Help them deepen their database expertise and take ownership of technical decisions. - Participate in on-call and incident response, leaving clear operational ownership and following through on lessons from production. WHAT YOU BRING - 8+ years operating and evolving production database estates at scale. You have assessed inherited systems, set technical direction and delivered improvements with engineering teams, and can explain how those decisions held up over time. - Strong understanding of high availability, replication and distributed database failure modes. You can explain consistency and availability trade-offs and reason about transaction boundaries and reliable event delivery, including transactional outbox patterns. - Deep, recent hands-on MariaDB expertise, including InnoDB, MVCC and transaction isolation, locking, query optimisation, binary logs and MariaDB GTID replication. You can explain the mechanisms and diagnostic evidence behind your decisions. - Personal ownership of MariaDB incident diagnosis, performance tuning and tested restore or point-in-time recovery. You can explain what you did, how you established data integrity and what remained uncertain. - Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust or a comparable language. You have personally built and maintained production software or automation for database workflows such as provisioning, failover, online schema changes and self-service operations, using version control, code review and delivery pipelines, with tested failure handling. - Strong low-level Linux, Kernel, storage and networking fundamentals, with the ability to investigate problems beyond the database process. - Clear written technical judgment and demonstrated delivery across teams without reporting-line authority. You help stakeholders make sound database design and lifecycle decisions, and develop experienced engineers through shared delivery. NICE TO HAVES - Experience operating databases in containerised, hybrid on-premises/cloud or multi-region environments. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or GitOps, including their operational trade-offs. - Experience with database proxies or load-balancing layers (MaxScale, HAProxy, ProxySQL, or similar). - Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse or internal database platforms; operational knowledge of Kafka, Redis/Valkey or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. - Experience in regulated environments or contributions to database engines, operators and other infrastructure software. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.description: About the Team We are building AI systems that help people tackle complex, consequential work in the legal industry. Law demands careful reasoning, precise language, and sound judgment: understanding the facts, identifying the right questions, weighing competing interpretations, and helping clients decide what to do next. We see an opportunity for AI to help legal professionals work with greater rigor and focus more of their time on the problems that matter most. Our team works across Research, Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to build AI capabilities and products for legal work. Our customers include the top law firms in the world as well as in-house legal departments of some of the largest businesses in the world. We translate the realities of practice into evaluations, training signals, and useful tools, with the ambition of making AI a trusted part of how lawyers research, analyze, draft, and advise. About the Role We are looking for a Subject Matter Expert in Law who brings the judgment and practical experience developed in a law firm to shaping the next generation of AI. You will help define what excellent legal work looks like, test where our models meet that standard, and turn your findings into better model behavior and product experiences. This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of legal practice and AI development. You will work directly with legal materials, model outputs, evaluation rubrics, and product prototypes. Your expertise will help us tackle some of the hardest questions in legal AI, including how to assess reasoning when there is no single correct answer. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In This Role, You Will: - Define the quality bar for what top-notch legal work looks like, drawing on real matters and the standards lawyers apply to research, analysis, drafting, document review, and client advice. - Design challenging, realistic AI model evaluations with representative facts, source materials, constraints, and deliverables, including cases that test ambiguity, competing arguments, and professional judgment. - Create and review reference work such as research memoranda, contract analyses, redlines, diligence findings, and draft legal documents that demonstrate strong reasoning and practical usefulness. - Develop rubrics that assess legal accuracy, issue spotting, factual grounding, citation validity, jurisdictional context, and the appropriate treatment of uncertainty. - Evaluate model outputs and complete legal workflows, identify recurring failures, and give researchers and engineers specific, actionable feedback supported by examples and corrected work. - Partner with Research on datasets, grading methods, and training tasks or environments that strengthen legal reasoning. Test whether model changes address the underlying problems and improve performance on new cases. - Work with Product and Engineering to identify valuable use cases, prototype workflows, and translate lessons from evaluations into experiences that fit how lawyers actually work. - Collaborate with legal professionals and design partners to refine our standards and test usefulness in practice, applying sound judgment around confidentiality, privilege, data permissions, and professional responsibility. You Might Thrive in This Role If You: - Have practiced law at a law firm, with substantial experience producing and reviewing work for real client matters. We care more about demonstrated judgment and quality of work matter over title or firm pedigree. - Bring deep expertise in one or more practice areas, such as commercial transactions, corporate law, litigation, or regulatory work, and curiosity about workflows beyond your specialty. - Are an excellent legal researcher and writer who can assess authorities, distinguish strong arguments from plausible ones, and explain how facts and context affect a conclusion. - Can make expert judgment explicit: explain why an answer is incomplete, a clause creates risk, or an analysis misses the central issue, and describe what better work would look like. - Enjoy working directly with AI tools, exploring their limits, and testing ideas systematically. You can collaborate closely with technical teams and communicate clearly across disciplines. - Take ownership in ambiguous settings and are willing to build the first version of an evaluation, reference document, rubric, or workflow, then improve it through feedback. - Care deeply about the quality and consequences of legal work, and are motivated by the opportunity to help shape how AI supports the profession. items.title: Designated Technical Support Engineer - West
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for a talented Designated Technical Support Engineer to join our rapidly expanding, venture-backed startup. We are building a modern knowledge assistant personalized to every employee in your organization, making all information within your company accessible, contextual, and fresh. Our team works hard and plays hard. We are professional, creative, passionate, and most importantly - customer-obsessed. As a trusted technical resource to the customer, you will provide both proactive and reactive support to our growing customer base. By providing the highest level of service to our customers, you will ensure our customer experience is the best in the industry. You will: Own the proactive and reactive support for Glean customers by prioritizing issues for your designated customer(s) Meet with your assigned customers regularly to review issues and develop resolution plans and drive continuous improvement in how you and your Glean teammates provide support to them Be available to your assigned customers via collaborative communication channels consistently to ensure you are providing timely responses and updates on issues Create and maintain customer-specific runbooks and knowledge articles Provide first response, technical troubleshooting, resolution, and follow-through of customer issues and inquiries Assist customers in the configuration, set-up, and verification of new content sources and product features to enable them to realize additional value for their users Educate customers on the use of Glean product features Identify system and user health issues, then create and execute remediation plans while coordinating and updating the customer accordingly Handle customer-impacting alerts which require coordination with customer admin and system resources through resolution Work closely with teams across Glean to drive product, process, and service improvements Drive key improvement projects that will improve the scale and efficiency of support, while providing upgrades to the customers’ support experience Coordinate all support activities with your assigned customer(s), which may include more stringent access and security processes, ensuring you move with high urgency for their issues. Represent the unique needs of your assigned customer(s) with respect to product and security improvements that will improve the customer support experience Please note that this role will be dedicated to select customers and requires additional background screenings/clearances/training/certification, carry & use of customer-provided equipment, and extended on-call shift timing based on customer contractual obligations. About you: Technically curious: you have a never-ending desire to add technical knowledge and skills to your personal toolkit and share those learnings with your peers Fearless: you have an intense need to tackle the toughest customer issues and technically complex issues with the goal of driving customer satisfaction Strong communicator: you are a professional presenter with superior interaction skills with both customers and internal teams Detail-oriented: you are highly organized and methodical, ensuring all issues are managed to completion Data-driven: you utilize metrics and objective measurements to assess success and improvement opportunities for yourself and for the customer experience Key knowledge and skills required: Must-haves: Problem solving: technical problem-solving skills including the ability to troubleshoot and isolate issues to their root cause Ability to debug issues including searching & reading application logs, analyzing stack traces and browser trace files Experience in at least one of the following disciplines: Customer Solutions Engineering, Support Engineering, Professional Services Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: Search technologies, Knowledge technologies, SaaS-based system integrations Experience with Cloud technologies in at least one of the following: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure Must have experience in troubleshooting REST API issues Working experience on SSO, SAML, and OAuth along with network troubleshooting Able to fully document issues you manage and contribute to the support knowledge base Good-to-haves: Knowledge of SQL/database, Basic Kubernetes, Intermediate/Advanced Linux Experience in using Github, Jira & Confluence Basic knowledge of LLM’s and how GPT works Location: This role is remote but may require flexible working hours. Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $143,000 - $170,000 USD annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-REMOTE AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Strategic cloud and technology partners help enterprises adopt and scale AI within their existing technology environments. This role will lead OpenAI’s partnership with Oracle across North America, connecting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), its field organization, and relevant technical and delivery teams with OpenAI’s products and capabilities. You will turn the global alliance strategy into a focused North America business plan and repeatable field execution that delivers customer and commercial impact. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, enable responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work cross-functionally across Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success to translate strategic partnerships into measurable outcomes for customers. Global systems integrators and technology services partners help enterprises move from AI strategy to production deployment. This role will lead OpenAI’s global partnership with NTT DATA, bringing together its consulting, technology services, systems integration, and delivery capabilities with OpenAI’s products and platform. You will build the strategy, executive alignment, and operating model needed to turn the partnership into repeatable customer and commercial impact across regions and industries. About the Role We are hiring a Partner Director, Global NTT Data to serve as the single accountable owner of OpenAI’s strategic relationship with NTT Data globally. You will define the partnership strategy and joint business plan, build trusted executive relationships, and activate NTT Data’s regional, industry, sales, technical, and delivery organizations to accelerate enterprise AI adoption. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role with responsibility for the health, performance, and long-term expansion of the partnership. You will move between senior executive engagement, joint account and opportunity strategy, solution development, field enablement, governance, and day-to-day execution. You will align global priorities with regional execution and help customers move from initial AI strategy through secure implementation, production adoption, and expansion. The ideal candidate has led a global alliance with NTT Data or a comparable systems integrator, delivered measurable pipeline and customer outcomes, and built operating models that connect executive commitments to field behavior and successful deployments. You will bring commercial discipline, technical fluency, and the ability to align complex organizations while remaining accountable for results. In this role, you will: - Own the global NTT Data partnership, including alliance strategy, executive alignment, joint planning, pipeline growth, customer outcomes, delivery quality, and multi-year expansion. - Develop and execute a joint business plan with clear priorities, investments, decision rights, regional responsibilities, milestones, and measures of success. - Serve as OpenAI’s senior counterpart to NTT Data’s global and regional leadership. Build relationships across industry practices, consulting, sales, technology, alliance, and delivery teams to set priorities and resolve escalations. - Translate global partnership strategy into coordinated regional execution, working with OpenAI partner sales and account teams to establish clear ownership and consistent field engagement. - Lead joint account mapping, opportunity qualification, and strategic customer pursuits, aligning OpenAI and NTT Data teams around differentiated customer value and measurable commercial outcomes. - Shape joint solutions and industry-specific transformation offerings that combine OpenAI capabilities with NTT Data’s consulting, integration, application, data, cloud, and managed services expertise. - Engage with senior customer executives alongside NTT Data leaders to connect AI strategy, business priorities, implementation plans, and long-term value realization. - Create repeatable co-sell and delivery motions covering seller engagement, technical discovery, solution validation, delivery handoffs, production readiness, and customer expansion. - Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, Security, Legal, Finance, and Customer Success to remove technical, contractual, compliance, and operational blockers across priority engagements. - Build partner capability through field enablement, technical readiness, reusable solution patterns, and clear expectations for implementation quality and customer success. - Establish executive governance, business reviews, pipeline inspection, forecasting, performance reporting, and escalation mechanisms that create accountability across both organizations. - Define and monitor partnership KPIs, including qualified pipeline, conversion, revenue, production adoption, customer value, partner readiness, delivery quality, and return on OpenAI investment. - Prioritize OpenAI resources across joint opportunities based on strategic alignment, commercial potential, customer impact, delivery readiness, and repeatability. - Work with relevant teams to establish clear standards for security, responsible AI deployment, intellectual property, and quality across joint engagements and co-developed assets. - Represent OpenAI in senior partner, customer, and industry engagements, and help build the team capacity and operating model needed to scale the global alliance over time. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Significant experience leading strategic alliances, global systems integrator partnerships, ecosystem sales, business development, or enterprise GTM programs in AI, cloud, data, SaaS, or enterprise technology. - Deep familiarity with NTT DATA or a comparable global technology services organization, including its organizational structure, commercial incentives, regional decision-making, and enterprise delivery model. - Proven ownership of global, multi-year strategic partnerships with executive accountability and measurable pipeline, revenue, adoption, deployment, or customer outcomes. - Experience designing and scaling joint operating models across large, matrixed organizations, including governance, account planning, resource allocation, enablement, delivery handoffs, and escalation. - Demonstrated success shaping and advancing complex enterprise transformation opportunities, engaging senior executives, and navigating procurement, security, legal, and implementation requirements. - Strong executive presence and the ability to earn trust with global partner leaders and customer executives while remaining close to commercial and operating details. - Commercial judgment and experience qualifying opportunities, managing forecasts, prioritizing investments, and making clear tradeoffs across regions, industries, and customer segments. - Technical fluency across enterprise AI, data, cloud and hybrid environments, integration, security, governance, and modern application architectures. - Experience translating technology capabilities into differentiated industry solutions and repeatable partner-led customer engagements. - Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to align Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and external partner teams without direct authority. - Prior people leadership experience, with the ability to coach others, develop talent, and build team capacity as the partnership scales. - Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across regions and cultures. - A builder mindset, high ownership, low ego, and comfort creating structure and momentum in an evolving environment while maintaining a consistent focus on customer value and responsible AI adoption. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. Non-technical hiring here is fast-moving, varied and rarely straightforward. You'll own searches end-to-end, working closely with hiring managers to understand what they really need, find the right talent and keep hiring moving. We're looking for someone who knows their market, has strong opinions backed by data, and isn't afraid to rethink the approach when a search isn't working. This is a hands-on role with plenty of ownership. You'll source, advise, problem-solve and close, while helping us continuously improve how we hire. AI should already be part of your recruiting toolkit, and we'll expect you to keep experimenting with how it can make your work smarter and more effective. What you will do Own end-to-end hiring across our non-technical functions, from kicking off a search and mapping the market through to assessment, offer and close. Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to understand their teams, define what great looks like and build hiring strategies that work. Find exceptional talent across a range of business and product functions through proactive sourcing, talent mapping and creative search strategies. Bring data and market insight into hiring conversations, spotting where searches are getting stuck and changing the approach when something isn't working. Use AI across sourcing, screening, research, market mapping and reporting, constantly looking for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of your work. Make hiring at MoonPay better. Share what works, challenge what doesn't, and contribute to improvements across our processes, tooling and ways of working. Strong sourcing and talent-mapping skills, with the ability to get beyond the obvious candidate pool and find great people others might miss. Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with a high level of ownership. Data-driven, curious and focused on quality, efficiency and continuous improvement. Confident influencing hiring managers and challenging thinking when needed. Strong practical use of AI in recruiting, plus a deep understanding of cryptocurrency and financial technology. Able to demonstrate how AI has improved your work and speak credibly about the crypto ecosystem and where it's heading. items.title: Principal Engineer, Privacy
items.location_text: Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is working on frontier AI systems that handle sensitive information at enormous scale. How we protect that data, and how we build privacy into our systems rather than bolting it on afterward, is central to our mission of building AI that is safe and beneficial. As one of our principal privacy engineers, you will be among Anthropic's most senior individual contributors on privacy. You will set technical strategy for how personal data is handled across products, research, and infrastructure, and execute the hardest parts of delivering it. You'll work at the intersection of privacy engineering, distributed systems, and AI safety, on problems without established answers. You will lead through influence, quality of thinking, and trust rather than formal authority. Key responsibilities Define and drive technical strategy and architecture for major areas of privacy, spanning product surfaces, research and training data, internal tooling, and multiple clouds Identify and lead the highest-complexity, company-critical privacy initiatives, guiding engineers across many teams. Be comfortable building the most difficult pieces yourself Architect the primitives that make privacy the default and the safe path the fastest one: data discovery, classification, lineage, purpose-based access control, audit, retention, deletion, and export Turn regulatory, contractual, and consent obligations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act) into enforced, continuously verified technical controls in partnership with Legal, Policy, and Compliance team Anticipate where AI capabilities, regulation, and customer expectations are heading, and position our systems ahead of them Mentor and develop staff and senior staff engineers, raise the bar for privacy design across engineering, and help hire senior privacy talent Represent Anthropic's privacy engineering to customers, regulators, standards bodies, and the research community Minimum qualifications A track record of operating as a Principal engineer or equivalent: setting technical direction that multiple teams adopted, and delivering company-critical, multi-year initiatives Deep experience applying privacy engineering principles in production systems with a large user base, including privacy by design, data minimization, and purpose limitation Experience architecting data governance infrastructure (classification, lineage, access control, retention, or deletion) across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages; you are effective writing design docs, making architectural calls, and coding in critical paths Understanding of privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, and the ability to work as a peer with legal and policy experts to turn requirements into technical designs Written and verbal communication that builds alignment across engineering, research, legal, and product teams, up to senior leadership Preferred qualifications Experience building privacy infrastructure or controls for machine learning or AI systems, including training data governance or AI agents Hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g., differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, secure enclaves, secure multi-party computation) Experience establishing or re-architecting a privacy engineering practice under enterprise-customer or regulatory scrutiny Experience briefing executives, auditors, regulators, or enterprise customers on privacy risk, and defending your recommendations under challenge A history of growing engineers into Staff-level and more senior roles Contributions to open-source privacy tooling, privacy research, or industry standards The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $485,000 — $625,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Intern - Central Gaming
items.description: This internship offers an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of iGaming, learn from industry experts, and contribute to the growth of an innovative gaming company. The Wow As an Intern - Central Gaming, you will play an important role in supporting the visual presentation of our gaming portfolio across multiple brands and markets. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, you will help ensure that game thumbnail requests are managed efficiently from submission through to delivery, while maintaining high quality standards and an organised workflow. Your contribution will help ensure our content is visually engaging, accurately represented, and delivered on time. A taster of what you will be involved with: Workflow Management: Maintain and organise the thumbnail production Kanban board in Jira, ensuring requests are properly tracked, prioritised, and updated throughout their lifecycle. Request Coordination: Submit thumbnail design requests in a timely manner and coordinate their progress, ensuring all necessary information and requirements are communicated clearly. Asset Management: Work with internal stakeholders to obtain and provide artwork, logos, game assets, and other materials required for thumbnail production, subject to availability. Quality Assurance: Review delivered thumbnail assets to ensure they meet brand guidelines, quality standards, and business requirements before approval. Content Administration: Upload approved thumbnail assets to the relevant Jira tickets and maintain accurate documentation of requests and deliverables. Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with various teams to provide updates, resolve blockers, and ensure requests move smoothly through the production process. Ad-hoc Requests: Support urgent and business-critical thumbnail requirements while balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Process Improvement: Contribute ideas and recommendations to improve workflow efficiency, asset management, and overall operational processes. Team Support: Provide operational and administrative support to the Central Gaming team and assist with other projects and initiatives when required. What we are looking for Strong organisational and time-management skills. Excellent attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously. Comfortable working with different stakeholders across multiple teams. Familiarity with Jira or similar project management tools is considered an advantage. Interest in gaming, digital content, or the iGaming industry is a plus. Proactive, reliable, and eager to learn in a dynamic environment. What we offer Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. Challenge accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy
