items.title: Learning & Instruction Lead, Academy
items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Washington, DC
items.description: About the Team OpenAI Academy helps people develop the skills and judgment to use AI effectively in their work and communities. We deliver practical learning through workshops, online resources, and partners who train others. Our audiences include small businesses, nonprofits, educators, workforce organizations, and people learning to use AI for the first time. The Academy team works closely with Customer Education and Technical Success to bring accurate product knowledge and strong instructional practices into community learning. This role will connect Academy’s audience needs with the training content, product expertise, and enablement practices across those teams. About the Role We’re looking for a Learning & Instruction Lead to own the design, delivery, and ongoing improvement of Academy’s learning programs. You will lead priority workshops, build live and self-paced curriculum, and develop the training, assessments, and credentials that prepare community trainers and advisors to support others. This role combines exceptional live instruction with hands-on learning design and program ownership. You will connect Academy’s audience needs with shared content, competency frameworks, and credentialing standards across Customer Education, Technical Success, and other education teams. You will create polished materials yourself and lead work with external learning partners, taking programs from an initial learning objective through launch and ongoing updates. In this role, you will: - Define competencies and learning paths for priority Academy audiences and community trainer and advisor roles. Map existing content to those needs, identify gaps, and establish clear evidence of product proficiency and readiness to teach or advise others. - Lead in-person and virtual workshops, hands-on labs, and priority Jams; adapt your instruction to different levels of experience and troubleshoot live questions and demos. - Create polished, ready-to-deliver curriculum, presentations, interactive learning experiences, and facilitator and participant resources. - Use AI directly in the design and production workflow to prototype, build, test, and refine training materials. Evaluate new capabilities quickly and turn useful advances into better learning experiences, with careful review for accuracy, accessibility, and reliability. - Partner with Customer Education and Technical Success to adapt shared resources for Academy audiences and keep programs current as products and learner needs change. - Test demos and activities in the accounts and environments learners will use, including access, feature availability, timing, privacy, and appropriate verification of AI outputs. - Own training and credential requirements for community trainers and advisors, aligned with shared OpenAI frameworks and Academy audience needs. Lead the development of assessments and credentials with internal experts and external learning partners, setting clear standards for quality and evidence of learning. - Prepare and coach instructors and mentors through train-the-trainer sessions, practice, and reusable guidance. - Partner with Academy program and partnerships colleagues to scope learning experiences that fit the audience, available staffing, and delivery capacity. - Manage external learning partners and coordinate internal contributors to develop, launch, and improve Academy programs. Own priorities, quality, and the overall learner experience. - Use learner work, feedback, and recurring product friction to improve programs and inform relevant internal teams. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have a track record of designing and delivering practical adult learning, customer education, technical enablement, or workforce training. - Have taken a learning program from design through launch and ongoing operation, coordinating content, assessments, learner access, and external contributors. - Are an exceptional live instructor with a track record of leading engaging, hands-on sessions, explaining complex ideas clearly, reading the room, and adapting in real time for beginners and experienced participants. - Use ChatGPT and Codex confidently to build, test, and refine practical demonstrations and learning resources, with sound judgment about accuracy and limitations. - Are an excellent learning designer who can translate an audience need into clear objectives, well-sequenced instruction, meaningful practice, and useful evidence of learning. - Have a portfolio of fully polished training resources that you personally created and brought to delivery quality, combining strong writing, visual judgment, instructional design, and attention to detail. - Have coached instructors or partners and can define observable standards for teaching readiness and quality. - Bring the judgment to distinguish a beginner workshop from a session requiring deeper engineering expertise and involve the right specialists. - Work well across content owners, product experts, program managers, and external partners, with clear ownership and follow-through. - Care about expanding access to useful AI skills and have experience adapting learning for varied professional and community contexts. Helpful experience - Train-the-trainer programs, facilitator networks, or partner-led education. - Learning assessment, accessibility, localization, or delivery to nonprofit, small-business, education, and workforce audiences. - Familiarity with APIs, agents, and evaluations to support collaboration with technical instructors and appropriate builder content. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. You will work closely with the People Ops team, assist with day-to-day operations, and take ownership of concrete projects, such as improving our HR documentation and helping coordinate onboarding for new joiners across EMEA. items.title: Member of Technical Staff (TPM, Compute)
items.description: Perplexity is looking for a technical program manager to own how we plan, bring online and run the GPU compute behind every product. Perplexity serves Ask, Computer and API traffic on GPU capacity across multiple cloud and neocloud providers, and demand shifts with every new customer, product launch and model release. Working across engineering, research, Finance and providers, you’ll forecast how much compute we need and when, bring new capacity into production, and own how the fleet performs today, driving fixes when reliability, utilization or cost fall short. The ideal candidate knows GPU fleets, handles technical and commercial details, and is energized by building a function with little precedent. OUR MISSION Perplexity’s mission is to power curiosity. Curious people are the people who drive change in the world. Driving change is a continuous cycle of learning, building, and integrating. Learn: curious people constantly learn new things by asking more. They question the status quo in their own expertise and they constantly learn outside of it. Research is essential to them and never ending. Build: curious people make and create things, to show the world their new answers to problems no one else ever questioned. They take action on what they’ve learned. Makers need tools to create their products, their companies, their reality. Integrate: they must interact with the world as it is to drive change and adoption. True leaders do not simply build something and hope. They must have armies of agents and workers who can constantly work in millions of small ways. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Partner with Finance on the compute demand forecast, 3–12 months out, driven by customer growth, model releases, and post-training and evaluation plans rather than trend lines - Turn the forecast into decisions with Finance and engineering leadership on commitments and budget, checking that new capacity fits the plan before we commit - Bring new capacity online and lead transitions, from contract to production, including provider onboarding, acceptance criteria, migration and decommissioning - Build a single, trusted view of the fleet: capacity, cost, allocation, and uptime, reliability and utilization by provider and workload - Drive daily utilization, reliability and cost-efficiency as core metrics, reclaiming idle capacity and surfacing trade-offs rather than letting them become side effects - Own inference and compute requests end to end: triage and resolve GPU, deployment and quota requests from teams across Perplexity, and build self-serve paths so routine requests no longer need a person in the loop - items.title: Design Operations Manager
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Design Operations Manager (DesignOps), you will sit within Mistral's Product Operations function, with a focus on streamlining the operations of the design team. You will own how the Design team operates as a system — its cadences, its rituals, its coordination, and the connective tissue that lets designers focus on design. This role exists because a design org at our scale needs someone whose full-time job is the operating system itself: defining it, holding it, and continuously tuning it so the team runs with a heartbeat rather than on ad-hoc heroics. You will own the team's weekly and quarterly cadences — from leadership syncs to planning, retros, and share-outs — and establish how we track work, surface it outward, and make decisions. You'll design the forums where decisions get made and recorded, keep the rituals that create alignment, and aggressively cut the ones that are just overhead. Equally, you are the bridge across the org. You will coordinate the interlocks between Brand and Marketing for upcoming launches, and between Product and Product Design for the build pipeline — so interdependencies are understood and planned for, not discovered at the last minute. You will partner closely with marketing, PMs, engineering, GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping before it ships. This is a team-of-one role with a founding design-ops mentality. You will build the discipline from scratch, automate repetitive coordination with AI where it helps, and coordinate people where it matters. You report to the Head of Product Operations, working day-to-day with the Head of Design and the design team. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Define the operating system of the design team — the cadences, forums, rituals, and source-of-truth that keep the team aligned and moving forward. - Own the weekly and quarterly cadences, from leadership syncs and critiques to planning, retros, and headcount-cycle inputs. - Coordinate the Brand × Marketing and Product × Product Design interlocks so design work is surfaced with enough lead time and dependencies are planned, not discovered late. - Establish how the team tracks and shares out work — a single source of truth for status, and the forums where design is made legible to the rest of the org. - Design and hold decision-making forums so decisions get made, recorded, and not relitigated. - Separate ritual from overhead — keep the cadences that create alignment and cut the ones that are just tax. - Automate repetitive coordination, reporting, and tracking with AI so the team spends time on design, not admin. - Bring the wider Product Operations toolkit to the design team — data and analytics for transparent reporting, structured feedback loops and early-access programmes, and launch coordination that aligns design work with product release cycles and go-to-market timing. - Partner with marketing, PMs, engineering and GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6–10 years of experience in design operations, product operations, program management, or a chief-of-staff role within a creative or product organization. - A founding design-ops mindset — you've built operational disciplines from scratch, not just maintained inherited ones. - Comfortable automating with AI tools to remove repetitive overhead, while equally skilled at coordinating people and building coalitions without authority. - Strong systems thinking — you design repeatable rhythms and processes, not just run meetings. - Design literacy — enough background to have felt the pain designers feel and to be credible with the team. - A make-it-happen attitude: positive, bias to action, unblocks rather than escalates. - Excellent communication and synthesis skills — you turn scattered signals into a shared source of truth. - Ability to thrive in ambiguity and define your own scope in a role with no playbook and no team to delegate to. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Our Raisin UK Finance team is expanding, and we are looking for a hands-on, commercially astute Senior Finance Manager to join our Manchester office. Working directly alongside the Head of Finance UK, this is a high-impact individual contributor role designed for an autonomous operator who thrives on ownership, commercial variety, and cross-functional leadership. With a primary emphasis on FP&A and commercial growth, you will bridge strategic forecasting, business partnering, financial reporting, and process automation in a fast-growing fintech scale-up. Your Responsibilities Financial Reporting, Controlling & Audit Support Own the preparation of timely, high-accuracy monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with UK GAAP/ IFRS, alongside insightful internal management reporting packages. Lead core operational accounting workflows, including revenue invoicing, reconciliations, and balance sheet integrity. Evaluate, establish, and continuously enhance internal financial controls, governance workflows, and accounting procedures. Serve as a key operational point of contact for internal and external auditors, ensuring smooth, efficient audit cycles and statutory compliance. Possess end-to-end knowledge of core accounting functions to provide seamless interim coverage and operational backfill across the finance team when needed. Financial Planning, Forecasting & Commercial Analysis Drive regular financial forecasting cycles, variance analyses, and the annual budgeting process for the UK business. Deliver regular, actionable analyses of trading performance, unit economics, and underlying revenue trends to inform operational strategy. Conduct ad-hoc financial and commercial analyses requested by local leadership and central Group Finance stakeholders. Finance Business Partnering & System Architecture Act as a trusted finance partner to commercial teams and operational leaders, guiding budget holders on spend optimization, ROI, and resource allocation. Champion financial process automation and AI adoption—leveraging modern workflow tools and AI-driven solutions to automate reporting, revenue recognition, invoicing, and billing cycles. Support the ongoing evolution of our controlling systems landscape and internal reporting architecture. Champion financial process automation—particularly around revenue recognition, invoicing, and billing workflows. Support local rollout and implementation of group-wide finance tools and enterprise systems. A recognized professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) is a distinct advantage. Technical Accounting Standards: Deep practical understanding of UK GAAP; working knowledge of IFRS is highly desirable. Systems & Digital Affinity: Strong tech acumen and proficiency with spreadsheet tools (MS Excel, Google Sheets) and modern ERP software (experience with Oracle NetSuite is a strong plus). Cross-Functional Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex financial contexts into clear, actionable narratives for non-finance stakeholders. Agility & Ownership: Proven ability to operate effectively and maintain exceptional accuracy in a fast-paced environment where problem-solving, adaptability, and execution matter. items.title: Field Marketing Manager, Korea
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the role You'll bring together two important parts of our go-to-market strategy. First, enterprise growth. You'll work with sales to build demand and accelerate opportunities across Korea's most important and highly regulated organizations, including the major conglomerates (chaebol), financial institutions, telecommunications companies, and other strategic accounts. Second, sovereign and public sector. Korea has a strong national agenda around AI capability, technology sovereignty, and digital government. You'll help build trusted relationships with government agencies, public institutions, and policy stakeholders through executive engagement, policy-led conversations, roundtables, and high-touch experiences. This is an opportunity to build the playbook rather than inherit one. As the first marketer in the country, you'll have significant ownership over strategy and execution, with the autonomy to experiment, move quickly, and see a direct connection between your work and Mistral's growth in Korea. WHAT YOU'LL DO CREATE EXCEPTIONAL FIELD EXPERIENCES - Own the strategy and execution of Korean events, industry conferences, executive briefings, customer experiences, and intimate leadership gatherings. - Develop experiences that go beyond traditional events, creating meaningful conversations between Mistral, customers, partners, and industry leaders. - Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, from developing the program concept to being on-site to make it happen. - Manage project timelines, vendor relationships, logistics, and speaker coordination with precision. - Establish Mistral's presence in key local moments, from AI and cloud industry events to executive forums and closed-door roundtables. CRAFT THE KOREAN MARKETING STRATEGY - Develop and execute Mistral's field marketing strategy for Korea, translating global priorities into locally relevant programs. - Work closely with the local sales team to identify market opportunities, priority accounts, and the programs that can have the greatest commercial impact. - Own and optimize the Korean field marketing budget aligned to GTM objectives. - Establish a clear view of marketing performance, from engagement and account penetration through to pipeline and revenue contribution; analyze results, extract learnings, and iterate. BUILD TRUSTED RELATIONSHIPS WITH GOVERNMENT AND PUBLIC SECTOR - Create high-touch marketing programs for government and public sector audiences, including executive roundtables, VIP briefings, and delegation visits. - Help position Mistral as a credible and trusted partner in conversations around AI, technology sovereignty, and digital transformation. - Work closely with sales and leadership to create meaningful engagement with senior government and public-sector stakeholders. ACCELERATE STRATEGIC ENTERPRISE ACCOUNTS - Partner with the sales team to develop account-based marketing strategies across priority accounts, including the large conglomerates and regulated enterprises that define the Korean market. - Create highly targeted 1:1 and 1:few campaigns designed to open doors, deepen relationships, and accelerate complex, relationship-driven sales cycles. - Connect campaigns, events, content, and executive engagement into cohesive account strategies that move opportunities forward. SUPPORT THE LOCAL ECOSYSTEM - Develop joint marketing and go-to-market programs with strategic local partners, including Korean GSIs, cloud providers, and technology partners. - Work with partners to extend Mistral's reach and create new opportunities for customer engagement. - Identify new partnership opportunities that can strengthen Mistral's position in Korea. BRING KOREA'S VOICE TO MISTRAL - Represent the needs, insights, and opportunities of the Korean market within the global marketing organization. - Partner with Product Marketing and Demand Generation to adapt global messaging, campaigns, and assets for the local market, including Korean-language localization. - Bring a deep understanding of local customer needs, culture, regulations, and competitive dynamics to inform our global strategy. - Identify what is working in-market and turn those learnings into repeatable approaches. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR MUST HAVE - 5+ years in field marketing (owned events, conference sponsorships, partner marketing, ABM). - Strong experience in the Korean market, with a deep understanding of its commercial and cultural dynamics; including how enterprise buying decisions are made and how relationships are built. - Enterprise B2B tech background, with an understanding of enterprise selling and B2B tech business models. - Experience marketing to enterprise, regulated, or public sector audiences, ideally with exposure to financial services, telecommunications, or government. - Experience creating high-touch executive programs such as roundtables, VIP briefings, customer events, or policy-focused engagements. - Strong understanding of account-based marketing, with the ability to build programs around strategic accounts and complex enterprise sales cycles. - Experience developing joint GTM or co-marketing programs with partners such as GSIs, telcos, cloud providers, or technology vendors. - Native-level Korean and professional fluency in English; able to represent Mistral confidently with senior audiences in both languages. - Strong hands-on project management experience and the ability to deliver in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. - Content creation skills, or the ability to collaborate with content and design teams. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in AI companies or marketing AI/infrastructure products. - Experience as a first-in-country or first-in-region marketing hire, building a function from scratch. FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS - Problem-solving and strategic thinking; able to translate business needs into an actionable field marketing plan. - Proactive, adaptable, hands-on. - Strong project management and creative thinking. - A strong commercial mindset: able to connect marketing activity to account engagement, pipeline, and business outcomes. - High ownership and low ego: comfortable creating structure where there isn't one, making decisions quickly, and taking responsibility for the outcome. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Applied AI Engineering Manager, Startups | Core
items.location_text: London, UK, Munich, Germany, Paris, France
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Applied AI Engineering team partners closely with customers to help them move from experimentation to production with OpenAI’s technologies. We act as trusted technical advisors, working across customer strategy, architecture, deployment, and adoption to help organizations realize meaningful impact from frontier AI. The Startups segment serves fast-moving, high-growth companies that are often building new products, workflows, and businesses directly on top of AI. These customers move quickly, operate with high ambiguity, and expect practical, creative, and technically rigorous partnership. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an Applied AI Engineering Manager, Startups to lead and scale the Startups Applied AI Engineering motion. This team helps high-growth startups move quickly from experimentation to production, unlock meaningful usage, and build durable technical partnerships with OpenAI. This leader will operate in a high-velocity customer segment where founders, CTOs, and technical teams expect speed, judgment, and hands-on problem-solving. They will balance team leadership, technical depth, customer prioritization, and cross-functional influence across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and broader go-to-market teams. In this role, you will define how OpenAI supports startup customers at scale: identifying where deep technical engagement can unlock outsized impact, building repeatable deployment mechanisms, and ensuring the team can serve a broad and dynamic customer base without losing quality or strategic focus. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Craft and continuously refine the strategic vision and operating model for the Startups Applied AI Engineering team, aligning it with OpenAI’s broader company objectives and the evolving needs of high-growth startup customers. - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of high-performing technical ICs supporting startup customers across AI-native, developer-led, and product-led companies. - Help startups move from early experimentation to production usage by identifying technical blockers, advising on architecture, and driving practical paths to deployment. - Partner closely with Sales to determine where technical engagement can accelerate adoption, production usage, and long-term account growth. - Represent the technical voice of startup customers by synthesizing high-signal feedback, especially around developer experience, product gaps, deployment blockers, model performance, and emerging use cases. - Translate recurring startup needs into repeatable playbooks, starter packs, reference architectures, internal tooling, and customer-facing assets that help the broader team move faster. - Serve as a senior technical escalation point for priority startup customers, including founder-, CTO-, and technical executive-level conversations. - Balance urgent customer needs with OpenAI’s broader product and platform priorities, especially when startups request niche features, bespoke support, or accelerated roadmap changes. - Coach Applied AI Engineers on technical quality, customer judgment, prioritization, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership. - Partner across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and other GTM teams to improve how OpenAI supports startups from early adoption through scaled production usage. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have proven experience founding, scaling, or operating within early-stage startups, ideally in technical leadership roles where you owned both product or customer outcomes and technical execution. - Have a strong track record of building and leading technical, customer-facing teams in high-growth, ambiguous, or startup-heavy environments. - Bring strong technical depth across APIs, platform products, AI/ML systems, developer workflows, and production deployment considerations. - Have experience creating scalable operating models, not just managing one-off customer escalations. - Are comfortable working directly with founders, CTOs, technical executives, and highly technical ICs. - Demonstrate strong judgment about when to go deep for a strategic customer versus when to build repeatable mechanisms for the broader segment. - Can translate complex technical and product considerations into clear decisions, practical guidance, and customer-facing recommendations. - Operate with speed, iteration, and pragmatic customer impact without sacrificing quality, safety, or OpenAI’s long-term platform strategy. - Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI. SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED BY: - A strong cadence of successful customer sprints and production-oriented technical engagements. - Strong Product and Research feedback loops informed by startup customer needs and emerging use cases. - Increased startup account usage, including tokens, requests, and production workloads. - High-quality customer stories, founder and CTO satisfaction, and referenceable startup wins. - Creation of repeatable startup deployment patterns, starter packs, templates, and reference architectures. - A healthy, high-performing team with strong prioritization, clear operating mechanisms, and the ability to scale coverage across a high-demand segment. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: SMB Lead - APAC
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As the APAC Corporate Lead, you will be the strategic force behind scaling and optimizing our Corporate AE organization across APAC. You’ll own revenue outcomes and team performance across our Corporate segment, with a strong focus on building repeatable, high-velocity sales motions. This role blends hands-on leadership with strategic execution in a fast-growing environment. 1. Lead, coach, and scale a team of Corporate AEs, owning recruiting, onboarding, enablement, and performance management. 2. Own pipeline health and forecasting, driving consistency and improving conversion rates across each stage of the funnel. 3. Develop and refine sales playbooks, motions, objection frameworks, and deal models tailored to Corporate segment buyers and voice AI / conversational use cases. 4. Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Growth, and Customer Success to align positioning, messaging, and expansion opportunities. 5. Establish feedback loops by synthesizing insights from prospects and customers to help inform GTM strategy and product roadmap decisions. 6. Help drive automation in the Corporate segment by turning repeatable sales workflows into AI-powered tooling that improves rep efficiency and consistency. Requirements - 5+ years of SaaS / technology sales experience as a top performer; prior sales leadership experience (2+ years) preferred. - Demonstrated success surpassing revenue targets in a Corporate or velocity-oriented sales environment. - Strong command of sales metrics, funnel optimization, forecasting, and process rigor. - Experience selling technical, AI, or API-driven solutions to Director- and VP-level stakeholders. - Excellent communication skills and ability to influence across teams and seniority levels. - Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with high ownership. - Fluent using AI tools in daily work; experience building or rolling out AI-driven sales workflows or tooling is a strong plus. Location This role is remote-first, however there is a preference for candidates to be based in Singapore or India with the option to work out of one of our offices. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.location_text: San Francisco, CA, Chicago, IL, Seattle, WA, New York City, NY, Austin, TX
items.description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role We’re looking for a commercial counsel who thrives on deal-making and loves turning legal complexity into business clarity. In this role, you’ll be the trusted legal partner to our sales and procurement functions, reporting to our head of commercial legal. You’ll be drafting and negotiating SaaS agreements that power our growth and keep our partnerships strong. If you’re energized by fast-paced negotiations with large enterprise companies, curious about cutting-edge technology, and excited to join a small-but-mighty team that values creativity and collaboration (all with a sense of humor and low ego) then, this may be the role for you. Come help us redefine what it means to be an in-house legal team - and have fun doing it. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do - Review and negotiate inbound and outbound commercial contracts, including inbound and outbound SaaS licensing agreements, strategic partnership agreements, data processing agreements and other important contracts with our enterprise customers and suppliers. - Develop and manage various contract templates and negotiation playbooks and improve efficiency of sales contracting processes in collaboration with sales operations. - Create thoughtful processes that benefit the business (not just legal) and how we support our internal stakeholders as we grow and scale - If you see something that doesn’t work, or could be better, we want you to help fix it! - Enable and train our go-to-market teammates by giving them practicable advice and guidance. ⭐️ What you need - A law degree from an accredited law school and admitted to practice law in the U.S. - 3+ years of experience negotiating commercial contracts, ideally at a SaaS company and/or law firm servicing tech industry clients. - Experience contracting with large enterprise companies and strategic partners, often in heavily-regulated industries (finance, healthcare, insurance). Bonus points if you’ve supported a global sales team with international offices. - Exposure to privacy, IP, and/or AI-specific legal issues, with a basic understanding of AI. We don’t need you to be an expert, but it helps if you know the basics. - Experience using contract management tools, in particular to help legal teams like ours continue to be data-driven. - Familiarity with legal operations, project management and CLM tools like Asana, Salesforce, Linksquares, etc. - A strong work ethic, the ability to think on your feet, and a sense of humor - we work hard, but we know how to have fun. - You are: - A business person first that also happens to be a lawyer. - Someone who can explain complex legal concepts in a non-legal way. - A redline machine! The end-of-month, quarter and year push is real, and we work fast under tight deadlines. Efficiency and the ability to prioritize and multi-task are must-haves. - A self-starter, who finds ways to add value without being told. - A partner - not a roadblock. We get things done! - Curious, reliable, comfortable moving uncomfortably fast, and - above all else - have a low ego. 🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees) - Generous PTO, plus company holidays - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks) - Fertility and family planning support - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri https://www.galleri.com/partner/writer - Flexible spending account and dependent FSA options - Health savings account for eligible plans with company contribution - Annual work-life stipends for: - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. - Learning and development stipend - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites - Competitive compensation, company stock options and 401k WRITER is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to diversity. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law. Under the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Many people joining us from the UAE are looking for clarity in scope and real ownership in their role. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. The team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform. About the Role We’re looking for an RTL Design Engineer to help design and develop next-generation AI accelerator silicon. In this role, you'll work across architecture, microarchitecture, and RTL implementation, translating complex system and performance requirements into efficient, scalable hardware designs. You'll collaborate closely with silicon architects, hardware and software engineers, verification, and physical design teams to co-design hardware solutions optimized for demanding AI workloads. This is a hands-on engineering role with opportunities to influence architectural decisions, drive microarchitecture development, and own RTL design from early concept through implementation and integration. We're particularly interested in engineers with experience in Network-on-Chip (NoC), networking, interconnect architectures, or high-performance data movement, though the role encompasses broader RTL design and hardware co-design challenges. In this role, you will: - Design and implement high-performance RTL for next-generation AI accelerator silicon, from microarchitecture definition through implementation and integration. - Collaborate with architecture and software teams to translate system-level requirements into efficient hardware microarchitectures. - Drive hardware/software co-design efforts to optimize performance, power, area, and scalability for AI workloads. - Develop and optimize RTL for complex datapaths, control logic, interconnects, and other critical silicon subsystems. - Evaluate architectural and microarchitectural tradeoffs across bandwidth, latency, throughput, and resource utilization. - Partner with design verification and formal verification teams to ensure functional correctness, develop verification strategies, and debug complex design issues. - Work closely with physical design teams to optimize RTL for synthesis, timing closure, power, and area. - Contribute to architecture reviews, design specifications, and cross-functional discussions to influence future silicon designs. - Support block-level and SoC-level integration, debugging, and performance optimization. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have strong hands-on experience with ASIC RTL design and microarchitecture development using SystemVerilog or Verilog. - Have experience designing and implementing complex digital hardware blocks, from architecture and specification through RTL development and verification. - Understand hardware architecture and microarchitecture tradeoffs, including performance, power, area, latency, and throughput. - Have experience collaborating across architecture, software, verification, and physical design teams to develop optimized hardware solutions. - Can reason about complex hardware systems, identify performance bottlenecks, and translate architectural requirements into efficient RTL implementations. - Have experience with synthesis, timing closure, and physical implementation considerations. - Enjoy working on ambiguous, technically challenging problems and taking ownership of designs from concept through integration. - Bring experience with Network-on-Chip (NoC), networking, interconnect fabrics, packet-based architectures, or high-bandwidth data movement systems. - Experience with AI accelerators, high-performance computing, or hardware/software co-design is a plus. The Applied AI team is Mistral’s customer-facing technical organization, working directly with enterprise clients from pre-sales through implementation. items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Claude Design
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude Design lets anyone collaborate with Claude to create polished visual work: interactive prototypes, product mockups, slides, and animations. We're making Claude the best visual storyteller there is, lowering the floor so anyone can bring an idea to life, and raising the ceiling on what the most skilled creators can make. We work on Artifacts in Claude, and so far we've shipped new kinds of artifacts like Claude Design, Slides, Whiteboard , and Motion, and we are exploring new bets. We're looking for Software Engineers to help build and shape Claude Design and the creative capabilities of Claude. We are exploring the frontier of how Claude collaborates with people visually, and how Claude can empower better human to human collaboration as well. You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world application, rapidly building and testing new experiences, partnering directly with researchers and users, and helping to generate the crucial insights that shape where the product goes next. You'll join a small, fast-moving team with high autonomy. If you're a strong design engineer who loves building visual products and likes to sweat the details, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Build and ship user-facing features across our products, and help decide which creative spaces we explore next Set technical direction for these products, including editor and canvas architecture, real-time collaboration, and rich import and export Own the quality bar for how these products look and feel, treating latency, responsiveness, and reliability as first-class concerns and raising user experience and design considerations early Partner with researchers to rapidly prototype experiences around vision and generation capabilities, and help improve the quality of what Claude generates Spend time with users and dig into how people actually use what you ship, then turn what you learn into what we build next Build the shared foundations that let us launch new creative tools quickly and make them work well together Minimum qualifications Strong design sensibility and a high bar for craft, including attention to interaction details, motion, and polish Ability to thrive in ambiguity and be energized by uncertainty High agency, good judgment about what matters, and a bias toward shipping A deeply user-centric approach: you validate ideas with actual users before over-investing and talk about problems before solutions Strong opinions held loosely: you advocate forcefully for ideas but change your mind based on evidence Care for Anthropic's mission and the societal impacts of your work Preferred qualifications Extensive experience working with or building visual collaboration and creative tools Experience with UI and UX for AI-powered applications, and fluency collaborating closely with designers Background conducting user research, interviews, and usability testing Experience building and shipping products from 0 to 1 Experience building product platforms, primitives, or shared foundations that other products and teams build on top of Performance optimization experience, such as profiling, improving rendering, and tracing end-to-end latency The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Security Risk & Compliance, SOX IT
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security and control commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building continuous assurance, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits. As Anthropic scales to meet public-company standards, the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control environment over our technology stack is one of the most consequential things this team will drive. Within Security GRC's technical controls assurance function, you will be a hands-on senior contributor on what the IT general controls must achieve to support SOX 404 compliance. You will work as a peer to Internal Audit's IT SOX team: Internal Audit tests independently, and you define the control requirements, monitor that controls operate, and make sure evidence is audit-ready before Internal Audit and our external auditors test it. You will pair with Engineering, Security, IT, and Finance as they design and implement against those requirements, and validate that what ships actually meets the bar. You will also work with GRC engineering to automate evidence collection and continuous monitoring, starting with ITGCs and extending into other areas of security and compliance. This role reports to the Head of Security Controls Assurance and is well suited to someone who wants to stay close to the work and change how a frontier AI company builds its compliance infrastructure. Key responsibilities Define control requirements and acceptance criteria across the core ITGC domains of logical access, change management, operations, and program development for SOX in-scope systems, including home-built platforms where the control has to be designed into the system. Set the bar for in-scope systems from day one. As financially significant systems are built, migrated, or replaced, define what the system must provide before go-live, and assess SDLC controls for new system implementations and changes so controls are not retrofitted after the fact. Pressure-test changes for SOX impact during design. Review major infrastructure, system, and agent framework changes for control impact while decisions are still cheap, and keep a clear view of which changes alter the SOX scope, key control population, or evidence requirements. Perform second-line monitoring and readiness testing. Test key ITGCs and IT automated controls (ITACs) ahead of Internal Audit and the external auditors, including walkthrough preparation and validation that populations are complete and accurate, and support the move from manual to automated control reliance. Build continuous monitoring and evidence readiness with GRC engineering. Stand up automated evidence collection and monitoring for ITGCs, map controls to the common controls framework, and materially raise automated evidence coverage while cutting audit prep time. Run system and process risk assessments. Identify control gaps in in-scope systems and processes, and recommend remediation that engineering owners can act on. Drive control deficiency remediation with cross-functional partners. Track and root-cause ITGC deficiencies surfaced by monitoring, Internal Audit, or external audit; partner with engineering owners on remediation design; and assess whether remediation actually closes the gap before re-testing. Support the external audit with Finance and Internal Audit. Prepare walkthroughs, evidence requests, and testing schedules on management's side, and keep the line clear between your monitoring and Internal Audit's independent testing. Assess scope changes through a SOX lens. When new products, entities, systems, or integrations come into scope, assess their impact on control design, evidence requirements, and engineering effort before commitments are made. Maintain alignment with the broader compliance portfolio. Support the controls and evidence behind SEC cybersecurity disclosure requirements. You may be a good fit if you Thrive at the pace of a hypergrowth company. You're comfortable making calls with incomplete information and reprioritizing as scope shifts. Have been a senior contributor to an ITGC program through SOX 404 readiness and/or at a public company, with a working command of PCAOB AS 2201, COSO 2013, and how external auditors scope, test, and evaluate technology controls and deficiencies. Have hands-on IT audit or IT SOX experience designing, testing, and documenting controls across access management, change management, and operations. Have hands-on engineering fluency, possibly from an earlier engineering career: you can read code and Terraform, follow a CI/CD pipeline end to end, and challenge a design on its technical merits. Have deep familiarity with developer platforms, release engineering, cloud infrastructure, or ERP/financial systems control domains. Are a strong collaborator and communicator across Finance, Engineering, Internal Audit, and external auditors, and can work independently on complex workstreams while keeping senior stakeholders informed. Use Claude and other LLMs as daily working tools, and have grounded, specific views on which SOX assurance workflows AI can run today and which it can't yet. Translate SOX and framework language into acceptance criteria engineers can build against, and translate engineering reality back into assurance language auditors and leadership can rely on. Default to getting the requirement designed into the system rather than papering over the gap with procedure. Strong candidates may have A combination of audit or advisory experience (Big 4 or equivalent, ideally IT audit) with in-house experience at an AI-forward tech company, in either order. 12+ years of hands-on IT audit and SOX compliance experience. Taken a company through a first-year SOX 404(a) and 404(b) assessment, including a first external ITGC audit. Experience at a pre-IPO or newly public technology company. Defined or assessed controls over home-built financially significant systems, usage-based billing, or revenue metering pipelines. Defined or assessed controls for AI/ML systems or agents acting in production environments. Stood up continuous controls monitoring or automated evidence programs. Experience with SOC 1 reliance, service organization control mapping, and complementary user entity controls. Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $270,000 — $345,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Staff Software Engineer
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,300 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in BordeauxAre you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As a Staff Software Engineer, and as part of the Offer Core Tribe in the Sporstbook universe, you will be responsible for building the best possible offer for our players, by driving impactful changes, giving technical quality guidance to the squads and solving the most complex problems throughout the codebase. At Betclic, technological performance is at the heart of everything we do: In-house developed systems for full control over the offer value chain: real-time offer creation, ingestion, processing and serving, capable of handling massive traffic spikes. In-house developed Risk detection and management platform operated by our internal Risk Trading team: fast, scalable, observable, at the heart of the critical path of the bet placement process. Tech teams organized into autonomous squads and tribes, each responsible for a specific functional and technical domain, enabling end-to-end project ownership: development, load testing, delivery, and production monitoring (monitoring, alerting). By joining our teams, you will become part of a Tribe that is at the core of our Sportsbook universe, with high challenges in terms of performance and scalability while still providing the best in class offer to our customers. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 The Staff Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for ensuring alignment and consistency across all squads within the Tribe. Reporting directly to the Tribe’s Head of Engineering, they play a key role in delivering technical solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with the Tribe’s long-term engineering strategy. This role is focused on solving cross-cutting technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and enabling the delivery of high-quality, effective software at scale. Staff Engineers are expected to proactively identify and lead high-impact technical initiatives, while working closely with product teams and squads to transform complex, high-value ideas into robust and reliable solutions. In this role, your main missions will be: Partner with Tribe leadership to align technical direction with strategic priorities and deliver business value. Lead architecture reviews, building with the team simple solution to complex problems. Lead cross-team technical and product initiatives, providing technical guidance to the product discovery, helping align solutions and streamline communication during the delivery. Mentor and support engineers, helping them solve complex problems, improve technical skills, and grow professionally. Identify high-impact technical or product challenges and proactively design and drive scalable solutions. Monitor platform health and costs, to ensure that we provide 24/7 the best experience to our customer in a cost efficient manner. Technical environment: C# / .NET 10, Rust, Python Cloud-first: AWS / Terraform as Infrastructure as Code Databases: MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, AWS Aurora Messaging: Kafka, SNS/SQS APIs: gRPC & REST AI Agents running on LangChain Datadog: Logs, APM, Alerting, etc. Low latency / High availability / High data throughput WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! This job is made for you if: You pursue engineering excellence with a pragmatic, critical mindset, and you can pass down this philosophy to your Tribe's engineers Proven ability to influence beyond teams boundaries, communicating with a diverse audience of stakeholders. You have a proven track record in building and leading highly scalable & highly performant complex distributed systems. Production reliability, performance optimization and security concerns are integral parts of your development approach. Expertise of the C#/.Net ecosystem is highly appreciated, if not, expertise in a similar language like Java/Kotlin/Go can be discussed. You are interested in AI solutions, especially in the GenAI area. Fluency in english. We have big ambitions, and we’re counting on your motivation, your ideas, and your drive to keep growing to help us reach our goals. We see Staff Engineers as equally strong in communication, critical thinking, and system design as they are in writing high-quality code. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS?📝 If your application is selected, Maxime will contact you within a week for a 30-minute HR pre screening. You will then meet one of Betclic’s Engineering Director. Next, you’ll be asked to complete a technical test with one of our .NET experts followed by a system design test. We’ll also invite you to take the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation, and reasoning). Finally, you’ll have a final HR interview, where we’ll review and discuss your AssessFirst results together. To ensure the best possible candidate experience, Betclic’s recruitment process takes an average of 4 to 6 weeks. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux, remote work possible from another city (on-site presence required 4 days a month) 📍 Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.description: About the Team OpenAI's Marketing team helps people understand and use AI responsibly. We work with Research, Product, Design, Communications, and Creative to turn complex capabilities into clear stories, useful examples, and experiences that help audiences understand what the technology can do. About the Role As a Research Product Marketing Manager, you will help translate OpenAI's research into accurate positioning, compelling demonstrations, and launch narratives. You will work closely with researchers and product teams to understand new capabilities, the evidence behind them, and their limitations, then explain why they matter to the audiences we want to reach. You will connect technical understanding with audience insight, carrying work from the initial brief through launch and follow-through. This is a hands-on role for a marketer who can ask precise questions, write clearly, and help teams make sound decisions as research and product plans evolve. In this role, you will: - Develop positioning and messaging for research capabilities and releases, grounding claims in evidence and clearly distinguishing demonstrated results from possible applications. - Partner with researchers and product leads to understand how capabilities work, where they are useful, and what limitations or caveats audiences need to know. - Define priority audiences and questions for each initiative. Use research, feedback, and usage signals to identify barriers to understanding and opportunities for useful adoption. - Build launch briefs that connect the research story, audience needs, communications goals, and the work required from cross-functional partners. - Work with Creative, Design, and technical collaborators on demonstrations, examples, and educational content that make complex ideas understandable without overstating performance. - Coordinate messaging and launch materials with Research, Product, Communications, and other relevant review partners, keeping descriptions consistent as plans change. - Turn audience feedback and launch results into recommendations for clearer explanations, stronger examples, and sustained education beyond the initial announcement. - Establish measures of audience understanding, engagement, and adoption with analytical partners, and communicate findings with appropriate limits and practical next steps. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a founding Staff Software Engineer on the AI Developer Productivity within the Institutional Product Group, you'll build and roll out agentic AI workflows that transform how Institutional engineers write, review, and ship code. This team is aligned with Coinbase's AI developer tooling vision but dedicated to the unique needs of Institutional's trading, custody, and financial infrastructure systems. You'll own the design and delivery of AI-powered capabilities that drive continuous code improvement, accelerate development cycles, and raise the quality bar across one of Coinbase's most critical product groups. What you’ll do: Own the architecture and delivery of agentic AI workflows for continuous code improvement, including automated refactoring, test generation, and proactive bug detection tailored to Institutional systems Build developer productivity tooling that integrates LLM-powered agents into the Institutional engineering workflow, from code review through deployment Partner with Platform's AI and DevX teams to align on shared infrastructure while customizing capabilities for Institutional's unique reliability, security, and regulatory requirements Drive adoption of AI-assisted development practices across Institutional engineering, measuring impact on velocity, code quality, and developer satisfaction Shape technical standards and best practices for human-AI collaborative development within the Institutional org, ensuring safe and governed use of AI agents in high-stakes financial systems Required skills and experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 2 years building AI/LLM-powered developer tools, agentic workflows, or code automation systems Proven track record of designing and shipping production-grade systems that integrate LLMs or AI agents into software development lifecycles (e.g., code generation, automated review, CI/CD automation) Deep fluency in Java, Python, Go, or similar backend languages, with hands-on experience building and orchestrating AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, or custom agent architectures) Demonstrated ability to partner cross-functionally with platform, infrastructure, and product teams to deliver tooling adopted by hundreds of engineers Familiarity with financial systems, high-reliability engineering, or regulated environments where correctness, auditability, and security are non-negotiable Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
