items.title: Adoption Specialist - Infrastructure & Agentic
items.location_text: Toronto, Europe, Canada, London, United States, New York, United Kingdom, Atlanta
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why This Role? This role is the critical bridge that amplifies Cohere’s ability to execute from its deployed engineering teams into the partner ecosystem at scale. You will be the single point of influence who takes the high quality of our engineering delivery and extends it outward, ensuring that system integrator partners can deliver Cohere solutions with the same rigor, reliability, and innovation as our internal teams. As an Adoption Specialist, you will design, build, maintain, and deliver certification programs that validate partner expertise across infrastructure and agentic domains. You will report functionally into Customer Education & Transformation, with a dotted line into the Forward Deployed Engineering teams (Infrastructure and agentic), ensuring that every certification, every training program, and every competency standard reflects the latest innovation and the highest standards of delivery. We are seeking a unique individual: someone who is customer obsessed, has a background in infrastructure engineering with the technical grit and expertise to be a de facto member of the deployed engineering teams, while also bringing commercial acumen to scale these capabilities across the partner ecosystem. You will be the conduit between our internal engineering excellence and the broader market, and you will be the face of this program in front of partner networks and communities. In this role, you will: - Design, build, and maintain certification programs for system integrator partners across both infrastructure and agentic tracks, ensuring they reflect current technical realities and future innovation. This includes train-the-trainer programs with key system integrators that can certify on our behalf. - Develop deep subject matter expertise in end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout. As well as assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices. - Develop deep subject matter expertise in applied AI across the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows - Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineering teams on a dotted line basis to ensure certification content stays current with product innovation and hands-on development. - Collaborate with Product to ensure requirements are adapted into the core product. - Create dynamic training programs and enablement assets that drive self-service enablement and partner competency, building educational content specifically for developers. - Deliver the certification and education program publicly, serving as the face of this initiative to partner networks, partner communities, and customer communities, with the exposure and visibility that comes with representing Cohere’s technical excellence externally. You may be a good fit if your experience covers the following areas: - Execution flexibility in fast-paced environments, with the ability to work across infrastructure, and agentic areas. - Infrastructure and cloud expertise including enterprise software deployment in private/hybrid cloud environments, production Kubernetes administration, Helm, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and version control. - Agentic and LLM stack expertise encompassing production-grade Python software development, RAG and agentic applications using patterns like ReAct or Plan-and-Execute, and robust evaluation framework design. - Developer relations and community engagement, including public speaking, presenting, with a natural comfort with visibility and being the face of technical initiatives. - Experience building enablement or education content specifically for developers. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. As a Senior Software Engineer on the CEE Surfaces team within Coinbase's Customer Experience and Engagement org, you'll build and scale the customer- and agent-facing support experiences that power Help Center, chat, in-product entry points, and agent tools. This team owns high-impact CX journeys spanning React/TypeScript frontends, Go backend services, and integrations with CEE Foundations and Intelligence layers. You'll ship reliable, measurable features that improve automation, resolution quality, and customer satisfaction across every support surface. Proven track record with distributed systems and production fundamentals including API design, caching, observability, debugging, incident response, and operational reliability. This is a high-ownership role managing pre-match and live sportsbook exposure. We need a sharp, high-conviction analyst who can instantly distinguish between standard recreational variance and exploitative sharp play. Balancing 360-degree cross-platform oversight across both Casino and Sportsbook, you will protect our bottom line and secure long-term margin sustainability without sacrificing customer experience. items.title: Product Marketing Manager, Knowledge Work - Enterprise
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role There are close to a billion knowledge workers in the world, and only a small fraction of them have worked with AI that makes them better at what they do. In the enterprise, reaching the rest depends on the IT, security, and business leaders who decide whether to adopt AI, and the admins who decide how it's deployed, governed, and scaled across their organizations. They ask hard questions before they say yes, and this role owns how we answer them. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own positioning for Claude's core knowledge-work products (Chat, Cowork, and the broader non-coding suite) for enterprise decision makers and admins. You'll work across the areas that matter most to enterprise customers today: security and observability, workspace management and deployment controls, and pricing and packaging. You'll own the materials that help a decision maker or admin understand what's possible, roll Claude out with confidence, and make the case internally, including product launches, the website, pitch decks, battlecards, persona narratives, pricing and packaging story, and admin communications. Beyond making the case for adopting AI, you'll help the people accountable for deploying it do that safely, and show them exactly how to put it to work across their organizations. This is an individual-contributor role for someone who loves the hands-on work of product marketing, on products with enormous, established usage and a fast launch cadence. You'll write the positioning doc, build the battlecard, and ship the persona work yourself, and you'll use Claude to keep it all current, so the teams that depend on it can trust it. This role is for you if you've owned the full product marketing stack for a widely used enterprise product and know how to speak credibly to business, IT, and security audiences. You probably also turn your own PMM work into systems rather than one-off documents, and you want your writing to be the reason enterprise decision makers and admins say yes to rolling out and scaling Claude. Key responsibilities Define the story that earns enterprise trust. Own the positioning and messaging house for Chat, Cowork, and Claude's core knowledge-work products for admins, so every deck, campaign, and piece of content makes the same case for adopting and scaling Claude. Own the story for how enterprises run Claude. Lead positioning and launches across security and observability, workspace management, and the controls for managing deployments, working with Product to turn new capabilities into clear reasons to adopt and expand. Give sellers the conviction to close. Build and maintain the sales enablement assets (pitch decks, battle cards, objection handling) that help GTM answer security, deployment, and pricing questions with confidence. Help decision makers and admins make the call. Own the proof points, comparisons, and narratives that help decision makers, admins, and their IT and security teams evaluate Claude and justify the investment and rollout internally. Make our pricing and packaging easy to understand and buy. Partner with Product, Finance, and GTM on how we present plans, pricing, and packaging for Claude Enterprise, and build the cost and value story that helps customers make the case to scale. Make sure the message reaches the right person, in their language. Develop ICP and persona frameworks that cover a varied base of enterprise decision makers and admins (executive buyers, IT, security, compliance, and workspace owners) in enough detail to shape messaging and campaigns for each one. Make our website answer buyers' questions. Own the website and product page messaging for Claude Enterprise, including how we present admin controls, security, governance, and plans and pricing. It's often where a buyer or admin decides whether to take a closer look. Turn scattered wins into a playbook others can run. Build libraries of top enterprise deployment and admin use cases by product and by function or industry, so the best examples of successful rollouts become patterns anyone can copy. Prepare admins for what's next. Partner with Product and Comms on enterprise launches so admins know what's changing, what controls they have, and what to do next, through clear admin communications, help content, and ongoing education. Keep every team telling the same story. Partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Partners so they're always working from current, consistent materials. "Claudify" our own foundations. Use Claude, including Skills and automations, to build systems that keep positioning, messaging, personas, and enablement current, so you're working the way we ask our customers to work. Support analyst relations. Contribute materials for the enterprise knowledge-work portfolio where they overlap with your positioning and messaging work. Minimum qualifications Have owned positioning and messaging for an established enterprise software product, with decision makers and IT, security, or admin teams as a core audience Have worked on enterprise pricing and packaging, including how plans are presented, how changes are communicated, and how the value story holds up with buyers Have built ICP and persona frameworks and translated research into messaging that works across websites, collateral, campaigns, and content Have built sales enablement assets and worked directly with sales teams on objection handling and win/loss analysis Understand how enterprises evaluate, buy, deploy, and govern software, including identity and access, security and compliance review, data governance, observability, workspace management, and usage and spend controls Have strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to make technical topics clear and adapt tone and complexity across formats like pitch decks, web copy, battlecards, and admin communications Are comfortable operating autonomously as an IC, writing and shipping assets directly rather than through a team Demonstrate systems thinking, and the ability to move fast and with conviction in an always-evolving environment Are well-versed in using AI, especially Claude, to inform and automate product marketing work, and have built systems that update PMM foundations and share them with the teams who depend on them Have experience marketing AI or productivity software to enterprise decision makers and IT, security, or admin audiences Preferred qualifications 7+ years of product marketing experience with experience as a Senior PMM or PMM Lead at an enterprise productivity, collaboration, or knowledge-work software company with ownership of admin, security, platform, or pricing positioning Experience marketing to customers in regulated industries (e.g., financial services, healthcare) Experience building admin education or community programs Experience with analyst relations processes and reports (e.g., Gartner, Forrester) Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 2 days a week. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Account Director, Startups | New Business - UK&I
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the Role OpenAI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Director to join our Startups UKI Go To Market team. You will play a critical role in owning relationships with top startup customers and supporting them in building successfully on the OpenAI platform. We believe that many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications will be created by startups. The Startup Go To Market team’s mission is to help startups harness the power of AI models to drive these advances. You will support startups building effectively with OpenAI’s APIs, and provide access to OpenAI teams and expertise to support their growth. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and strategy. You’ll be responsible for serving as the primary relationship owner for a set of strategically important startup customers, as well as working across the OpenAI organization to help these startups accelerate their progress and be successful using our models. You’ll work cross-functionality with product, research, engineering, support, and solutions architecture to help customers get the most out of our models. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. In this role, you will: - Manage a portfolio of startups accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan. - Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects. - Own a consumption revenue target. - Manage consumption revenue forecasts. - Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders. - Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies. - Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering. - Serve as an advocate for improving the startup experience building with OpenAI, synthesizing product feedback from insights captured from our work with startups. - Closely monitor the industry landscape and startup landscape to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies. - Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates. - Support the development of company culture. We're seeking someone with experience in: - 6+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service. - Designing and executing complex deal strategies. - Experience working in or around the startup ecosystem, preferably as either a founder of a startup, an employee of a startup, or someone who worked with startup customers. - Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies. - Working directly with C-level executives. - Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders. - Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.). - Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. - Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. - Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. - Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions. - Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. items.title: Senior Counsel, Litigation (Safety)
items.description: About the Team OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises legal professionals from diverse fields, including technology, privacy, IP, corporate, cybersecurity, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. About the Role We’re growing our world-class Litigation and Regulatory team and seek an experienced counsel to support litigation matters related to AI model outputs, such as products liability and mass torts. This role is highly cross-functional across OpenAI, including work across our Legal, Communications, Global Affairs, and Executive teams. This role reports to our Deputy General Counsel. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Provide legal advice and counsel on a wide range of global litigation matters, including first-of-kind products liability, mass torts, model output liability, and commercial disputes. - Manage and oversee outside counsel in all aspects of litigation matters, including discovery, motion practice, trial preparation, and settlement negotiations. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather relevant information, assess risk, and develop legal strategies to resolve disputes. - Stay current on relevant laws, regulations, and industry trends, and provide updates and legal guidance to company leadership and stakeholders. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have at least 10+ years of combined litigation experience, including several inhouse at software/online technology companies. This will not be your first inhouse role. - Have prior experience working on MDLs/JCCPs and other large litigations. - Have a strong sense of ownership, are inquisitive and enthusiastic about AI technology/online platforms, enjoy being continually challenged, and can demonstrate sound judgment in ambiguous/unstructured/dynamic situations. - Have a JD and license or qualification to practice in CA About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Software Engineer-1, Money Movement
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Join the Money Movement team within the Developer product group and help build the infrastructure powering the future of global payments. CDP brings together payments, trading, wallets, and stablecoins through a single onboarding flow and self-service APIs. You'll design and build backend systems for stablecoin-based pay-ins, payouts, deposits, and withdrawals, enabling fast, secure, and scalable transfers that underpin how value moves across the Coinbase ecosystem and beyond. What you'll do: Own key projects end-to-end as the Directly Responsible Individual, driving stablecoin-based money movement features from system design through production deployment with high accountability. Build backend systems, infrastructure, and internal/external APIs that enable businesses and partners to embed stablecoin-powered payments into their products. Partner with Product, Design, Infrastructure, and Compliance to translate requirements into robust, scalable solutions that balance speed, security, and regulatory needs. Execute performance, scalability, and reliability improvements across distributed systems, identifying bottlenecks and driving fixes before they impact customers. Support the team's engineering quality through code reviews, architectural best practices, and contributing to patterns that raise the technical bar. Required Skills and Experience: 2+ years of software engineering experience building and operating backend systems, ideally in fintech, payments, or crypto. Proficiency in backend languages (e.g., Go, Java) and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP), with hands-on experience designing distributed systems and APIs. Track record of serving as DRI for technical projects, driving end-to-end delivery from system design through production deployment. Experience integrating with or building on blockchain or crypto technologies such as stablecoins, on-chain payments, or smart contract platforms (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Base). Demonstrated ability to write technical design documents and communicate architecture trade-offs to product and engineering stakeholders. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
